bands.description: Not yet productive. The issue is pre-productivity.

levels.label: Disengaged
levels.indicator: Fellow is not present mentally or physically. Supervisor reports absence, missed commitments, no initiative.

levels.label: Struggling
levels.indicator: Fellow shows up but cannot keep up. Frequent rework, low ownership, supervisor has to chase.

levels.label: Slowly Adjusting
levels.indicator: Effort is visible but output is inconsistent. Needs frequent direction.

bands.description: Fellow is contributing. Differences are in depth and independence.

levels.label: Task Completer
levels.indicator: Closes assigned tasks on time but does not initiate beyond the brief.

levels.label: Dependable Operator
levels.indicator: Reliable execution, no rework, but no system-level thinking yet.

levels.label: Reliable and Productive
levels.indicator: Owns workstreams. Supervisor trusts Fellow with cross-functional coordination.

levels.label: Drives Outcomes
levels.indicator: Connects work to a KPI. Proactively raises issues. Influences peers.

bands.description: Fellow is building durable capability inside the client org.

levels.label: Systems Builder
levels.indicator: Builds artefacts (SOPs, dashboards, rituals) that outlast the engagement.

levels.label: Org Multiplier
levels.indicator: Team members upskill because of the Fellow. Supervisor changes how they run reviews.

levels.label: Founding Caliber
levels.indicator: Operates as a peer to the founder. Drives a measurable shift in a primary KPI.
